blocks.goal: Extract the attribute/protocol enforcement and validation responsibility from Safelist into a new class (AttributePolicy) to reduce Safelist's public API surface and total method count. Move the maps and related helper methods that manage allowed attributes, enforced attributes, and protocols, and their protocol/URL validation logic.

expected_impact.rationale: A cohesive cluster of public configuration and validation methods (add/remove attributes, add/remove enforced attributes, add/remove protocols, preserveRelativeLinks setter/getter, isSafeAttribute, getEnforcedAttributes) plus supporting private helpers and maps will be moved into AttributePolicy. This directly reduces the number of public methods on Safelist (by 10) and significantly reduces its total method count and LOC by relocating large blocks of logic and data structures.

ops.details: Create new class org.jsoup.safety.AttributePolicy in the same package. Move the following clustered responsibility into AttributePolicy: the fields 'attributes', 'enforcedAttributes', 'protocols', and 'preserveRelativeLinks'; public methods addAttributes, removeAttributes, addEnforcedAttribute, removeEnforcedAttribute, preserveRelativeLinks(boolean), preserveRelativeLinks(), addProtocols, removeProtocols, isSafeAttribute, getEnforcedAttributes; private helpers getProtocolValue(Element, Attribute), isSafeProtocol(String, Set<Protocol>), shouldAbsUrl(TagName, AttributeKey), and private static isValidAnchor(String). The new class will reference Safelist.TagName, Safelist.AttributeKey, Safelist.AttributeValue, Safelist.Protocol and will expose necessary methods used by Safelist. Provide constructors: AttributePolicy(), AttributePolicy(AttributePolicy copy). The class will import org.jsoup.nodes.Attribute, org.jsoup.nodes.Attributes, org.jsoup.nodes.Element and use the existing nested types from Safelist (referenced as Safelist.TagName etc.).

Move the four data fields that hold attribute/protocol configuration into AttributePolicy. Remove them from Safelist. Initialize AttributePolicy from Safelist() constructor and copy constructor. Update Safelist constructors to create/copy an AttributePolicy instance instead of initializing the moved fields directly.

Move the listed public API and private helper methods into AttributePolicy. Methods that reference Safelist.tagNames or other moved fields will be adjusted to reference the corresponding data inside AttributePolicy. Remove the moved methods from Safelist. Adjust any visibility as necessary (keep the same access modifiers where applicable).

Add required imports to AttributePolicy: org.jsoup.nodes.Attribute, org.jsoup.nodes.Attributes, org.jsoup.nodes.Element, java.util.Map, java.util.Set, java.util.HashMap, java.util.HashSet, and any other collections used. Safelist will be updated to import AttributePolicy if necessary (same package so import not required).

Update Safelist constructors in-place to initialize and copy the new AttributePolicy instance instead of directly initializing the moved maps. The constructors remain in Safelist but their bodies are changed (not moved) to delegate initialization/copying to AttributePolicy(). This is represented as a MOVE_METHOD operation here because constructor bodies are updated to reflect the extraction.

Update internal references in Safelist to call into the new AttributePolicy instance (e.g., attrPolicy.isSafeAttribute(...), attrPolicy.addAttributes(...), attrPolicy.shouldAbsUrl(...)). Remove duplicate logic now provided by AttributePolicy. No external project files are changed in this block; external call sites will be handled by later mechanical updates if necessary.
